design.sensitive_condition_in_arms: declared (lens + gates given, nothing inferred); the undeclared card is built in code alongside for the safety count

p_search_moved.source: assumption; direction from research/03 Truth 2 'can't be bothered to look' (r/britishproblems 1uosc29, 507 pts). 1.0 is the decomposition reference (always finds a moved category)

compliance_c.source: assumption; there is no grounded card-follow rate. Headline at the conservative end

reactance_k.source: assumption; Brehm 1966; White et al. 2008; research/03:57

route_card_logit.source: assumption; nothing in sim/notice.py models 'told to look'. Spec asks for it in coefficients.json; kept here because this build may not edit coefficients.json

tau.source: assumption: abstain threshold on max posterior

visit1_route.source: assumption: shoppers know the as-built store (research/03 Truth 2, memorised route)

habit_formation.value: not modelled beyond the injected memory line
habit_formation.source: Lally et al. 2010 (median ~66 days): one trial is not a habit; 'repeat' means v3 -> v4 only

compliance_draw.value: hu(seed, agent, 'comply', 3) < c * reactance_k, drawn once at the first card (visit 3) and kept for visit 4
compliance_draw.source: deviation from spec 4.2 (which keys the draw by visit): a per-visit draw would need 4 visit-4 histories per shopper; the opt-in is modelled as a shopper-level decision so each shopper has exactly two potential paths (card path, control path)

memory_line.value: visits >= 2: third `habits` entry in the Jev shopper state, 'usually buys: <name> (n/v visits), ...' (top 4 by count)
memory_line.source: labelled injection, memory_injected_by: sim/visits.py; off with --no-memory-state

hfss_rule.value: exclude hfss OR barred_from_restricted (in scope with uncertain data)
hfss_rule.source: sim/layout_optimise.hfss, conservative reading of 'never offers an HFSS product'

p_take_card.value: P(pick_up|looked) * P(take|picked_up) from the surrogate, mixed by posterior
p_take_card.source: data/sim/layout/surrogate.json (cached Jev Nouls, no new calls)

preregistered_primary.definition: share of a shopper's habit items (taken in >= 1 of visits 1-2) taken again at visit 3
preregistered_primary.contrast: card world - control world, paired within shopper, at c=0.2, route_card_logit=0, p_search_moved=0.5
